title: Effect of interstitial oxygen/nitrogen on mechanical and wear properties of TiZrHfNb refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc-melting in a water-cooled copper mold, flipped at least seven times for chemical homogeneity under high-purity argon atmosphere, followed by casting into plates, annealing for 24 h at 1200°C, cold-rolled to reduce thickness by 20%, and annealed for 30 min at 1200°C.
